Very long: weeks or months (5,000 scraps that only drop from the Make Believe bosses on high difficulties, with a 20 h or 2 days and 20 h cooldown)

The {wiki:Illuminated Warrior Outfits|Illuminated Warrior Outfits} arrived with the Summer Update 2026 and belong to the {wiki:Make Believe Quest|Make Believe Quest}, in {wiki:Thalassara|Thalassara}. The base outfit is unlocked when you complete Make Believe and exchange **2,500** {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire}; each addon costs another **1,250** scraps (5,000 in total). The scraps only drop from the Make Believe bosses ({creature:Mimar Haffar}, {creature:Maior Domus} and {creature:Phosphorus (Final)|Phosphorus}) when you face them on a high difficulty of the {wiki:Boss Difficulty System|Boss Difficulty System}. With the complete outfit you get the achievement **Enlightened, Indeed**.
Wayland Smythers, next to the Venore temple (start of the Make Believe Quest)

**Addon 1:** exchange another 1,250 {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire}. **Addon 2:** exchange another 1,250.

Each character unlocks the difficulties on their own, by beating the previous ones.
An organised team: the fights force you to split the team by floors and by vocations (see section 3).

Do the maths before you start: it takes **5,000** {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} for the full outfit. In the few kills recorded on the wiki, {creature:Mimar Haffar} gave 20 scraps in 1 of 10 kills and {creature:Maior Domus} 18 in 1 of 9 kills, so expect a lot of fights.
On **difficulty 1** the bosses give no loot at all (nor Bosstiary progress). Raise the difficulty gradually: each level above 1 gives **+2% loot**, but also +10% damage taken and +5% monster health.
After you beat {creature:Phosphorus (Final)|Phosphorus} for the first time, a room opens with shortcut teleports to **all** the quest's bosses: use them to farm the scraps without redoing the route.
You choose the difficulty in a window that appears when you pull the boss lever; the fight starts from that window.
This guide summarises the Make Believe Quest; for every step in full detail also follow the {wiki:Make Believe Quest|Make Believe Quest} guide.
Thalassara is a kingdom cut off by coral reefs, near {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}. The whole quest (bosses and scrap exchange) takes place there.
Travel to **Venore**: at your city's boat captain say {key:hi}, {key:venore} and {key:yes}. {npc:Wayland Smythers} is next to the **Venore temple**, one floor above the ground floor.
Wayland Smythers, next to the Venore temple
First trip: talk to Wayland Smythers

The first time, you enter Thalassara as a stowaway, through the {wiki:Make Believe Quest|Make Believe Quest}. Talk to {npc:Wayland Smythers} and follow the conversation: {key:hi}, {key:danger}, {key:hear}, {key:Marrow}, {key:spherequake}, {key:moonsilver}, {key:Thalassara}, {key:headstart}, {key:threat}, {key:reputation}, {key:align}, {key:entity}, {key:find}, {key:proceed}, {key:captive}, {key:stronghold}, {key:further}, {key:yes}, {key:infiltration} and finally {key:yes}. He gives you access to the hidden warehouse where the supply ships for Thalassara are loaded.
Cross the warehouse disguised as a crate

In the warehouse, click the crate at the entrance to disguise yourself as a **cargo crate** and make your way to the **north-west** corner of the room. Do not let the guards get next to you (melee range), do not stand still on the same square for too long (your character sneezes and you get caught) and avoid the grates on the floor, which make noise and give away your position. In the north-west, enter the teleport: after a short cutscene you arrive in Thalassara.
The Venore warehouse: the way to the teleport in the north-west
Getting caught by the guards makes the crossing fail: always stay out of their melee range and keep moving.

{npc:Captain Fearless}, at the northern port of Venore, has **Thalassara** on his list of destinations for **500 gp** ({key:hi}, {key:thalassara}, {key:yes}). The wiki does not say whether he requires you to have already made the stowaway entry; if he refuses, do the previous steps first. The wiki also does not say where in Thalassara the boat docks.

TibiaWiki does not yet document any boat or teleport back from Thalassara to the mainland. In {wiki:Salgadara|Salgadara} there is an NPC with a captain's title, {npc:Captain Corsarah}, but the wiki does not describe her job or her routes. The guaranteed way out is a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (it comes from the Daily Reward and expires after 7 days) or a {wiki:Temple Teleport|Temple Teleport} from the Store (15 Tibia Coins): both take you straight to your home town's temple.
The Temple Teleport Scroll does not work in No-Logout Zones or if you have a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block: use it outside the boss rooms and after the combat block has worn off.
2. Base outfit, part 1: complete the Make Believe Quest

The outfit only becomes available after you finish the {wiki:Make Believe Quest|Make Believe Quest}. Here is the short version of the route with the coordinates; the fights are explained in section 3, because they are the same ones you will repeat to collect the scraps.

Once in Thalassara, walk **south-east** and go up some stairs to {npc:Mayor Pocaro}, the head of the village of {wiki:Salgadara|Salgadara}. He wants you to prove that you are not just another plunderer: you have to defend Salgadara in the next Moonspawn attack.

The attack happens **east** of the village. When it starts, several Moonspawns appear and, after a while, the {creature:Moonspawn Juggernaut}. Kill it and go back to {npc:Mayor Pocaro} to report. Every player who took part in the kill gets the quest log update.
Disguise yourself as a cultist in Recifar
Pocaro sends you to infiltrate the cult of white-robed figures. Go **south** to the **Recifar** area, kill a {creature:Cult Initiate} and use its corpse to disguise yourself. Then enter the teleport.

In the room there is a {item:Gong}, three coloured squares and a book to the north. Use the gong and watch the sparks around the book: memorise the **order and colour** of each one. When the sequence ends, repeat it using the devices just north of the coloured squares. If you get it right, every player in the room gets the quest log update.
If you get it wrong, strike the gong again and watch the sequence once more.
Enter the crater and defeat Mimar Haffar

Leave the room, follow the path **south-east** and enter the teleport that leads into the crater. Go **south** and up the stairs to the lever of the first boss, {creature:Mimar Haffar} (Moonstone Crater). The fight is explained in section 3.

Leave the boss room and the crater the way you came in (the wiki does not describe another exit). By defeating Mimar Haffar, you and your team gain access to the cult's base, **south-west** of Thalassara. Go in, walk **south** and enter the teleport to the **east**; go through the room until you find {npc:Doctor Marrow (NPC)|Doctor Marrow} locked in a room (in the {wiki:Radiant Skyhold|Radiant Skyhold}). Say {key:hi}, {key:capable}, {key:prison} and {key:explain}, and continue with {key:samples}, {key:interaction}, {key:believers}, {key:purpose}, {key:CREATION}, {key:failure}, {key:god}, {key:unpleasant}, {key:stopped}, {key:traitor}, {key:abomination}, {key:hesitate} and {key:helping}. He asks you to kill {creature:Maior Domus}, the traitorous butler who holds the spiritual key to the inner sanctum.

The {creature:Maior Domus} lever room is **five floors above** the entrance to the {wiki:Radiant Skyhold|Radiant Skyhold}. The way up is full of strong radiant creatures ({creature:Radiant Warden|Radiant Wardens}, {creature:Radiant Paragon|Radiant Paragons} and {creature:Radiant Acolyte|Radiant Acolytes}). The fight is in section 3.
Elite Fanatics and the final battle

After Maior Domus, leave his room and go through the teleports to the **north**. In the next room you pull the {creature:Elite Fanatic|Elite Fanatics} lever and, after them, you reach the lever for the final battle against {creature:Phosphorus} (in the {wiki:Radiant Ascendancy|Radiant Ascendancy}). It is all explained in section 3.
Teleports to the Elite Fanatics room
End of Make Believe and the shortcut room

When you defeat {creature:Phosphorus (Final)|Phosphorus} (on any difficulty) you get the quest log update, which gives you access to a teleport to the **south-west**, on the ground floor. There you meet {npc:Wayland Smythers} again and find **shortcut teleports to every boss** of the quest. From here on you meet the quest requirement for the outfit; all that is left is to collect the scraps.
Base outfit requirement met and shortcuts to every boss
3. Collecting the Scraps of a Radiant Attire (bosses and difficulties)

{item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} are stackable (0.30 oz each) and only the Make Believe bosses drop them. No NPC sells or buys them. The bosses use the {wiki:Boss Difficulty System|Boss Difficulty System}: the scraps only enter the loot from a certain difficulty onwards.

When you pull the lever of one of these bosses, a window opens where you choose the difficulty; the fight starts from that window. Higher difficulties have to be **unlocked** by beating the boss on the previous ones, and each character unlocks them on their own (the team has to move up together). Difficulty 1 is a learning mode (you take 50% less damage), but it **gives no loot** or Bosstiary progress. Each level above 1 adds +10% damage taken, +5% monster health and +2% loot; from certain difficulties (for example 10) new mechanics also come in.
Difficulty selection window before the Mimar Haffar fight
Radiant Skyhold, 5 floors above the entrance {coord:33974,32637,1}
2 days and 20 hours (20 min fight at most)
No loot data on the wiki for the final form (the only one that gives loot)
From difficulty 15 the three bosses can also drop the {item:Cloud In a Bottle} (Radiant Nimbus mount).

{creature:Mimar Haffar} is trapped in the middle of the lower floor, invulnerable behind a barrier, but he attacks anyone who comes close. The fight takes place on **two floors at the same time**: split the team between the upper and the lower floor. The **Paladins** and/or **Knights** stay downstairs to deal with the {creature:Trapped Soul|Trapped Souls}.

The {creature:Trapped Soul|Trapped Souls} wander around, become unstable every now and then (*"The soul is becoming unstable!"*) and explode 2 seconds later in a small radius, dealing agony damage equal to **25% of max health**. Later they walk towards the boss: each one that reaches him gives him a charge and makes him stronger. They are slow, have little health and only take **holy** damage (Paladins kill them); Knights can use Challenge and lead them **north**, next to the large lunar essence tanks, where they disappear (the Knight gets a counter that goes down every few seconds and heals the Knight; the effect is not yet well understood).
Move away from an unstable Trapped Soul: the explosion takes 25% of max health.

Downstairs there are two {creature:Energy Cannon|Energy Cannons}, to the **south-west** and **south-east**. A portal to the **south** leads to the upper floor (30-second cooldown, plan your trips). Upstairs, kill the {creature:Moonstone Miner|Moonstone Miners} and pick up the {item:Moonsilver Crystals}; carry them down or throw them into the teleports to the **west** and **east**. Downstairs, use the crystals on the cannons: each crystal gives 10 charges, so you need **10 crystals per cannon**. The crystals disappear shortly afterwards, so use them quickly.

Over time the {creature:Moonsilver Custodian|Moonsilver Custodians} come out of the cells on the upper floor and try to go down through the teleports to help the boss. Block them with your body, with a {item:Magic Wall Rune} or a {item:Wild Growth Rune}, or let them through if the team downstairs can handle them.

When both cannons reach 100 charges they become {creature:Energy Cannon (Charged)|charged} and fire at the barrier: the boss is released and vulnerable for **45 seconds**. Then he goes back to his spot, trapped, and the cannon phase starts again. Repeat until he dies.
To leave the crater, go back the same way; once you have finished the quest, use the shortcut teleports in Wayland Smythers' room.
Maior Domus: phase 1, charging the plates

In the room are {creature:Maior Domus} and several {creature:Moonsilver Guardian|Moonsilver Guardians}. In this phase the boss has a yellow shield and heals about **23,000 health for every hit** he takes. Kill the guardians (they heal in an area, so split them up if you lack damage). Each guardian killed raises one of two charges: the **west** plate's charge goes up when Knights or Monks dealt most of the damage (20 charges fill it); the **east** plate's goes up when Paladins, Druids or Sorcerers dealt most of the damage (30 charges). With 20+ and 30+ the **south** plate is charged as well. With all three plates charged, the guardians disappear and phase 2 begins.
Do not hit the boss while he has the yellow shield: each hit heals him 23,000.
Maior Domus: phase 2, using the plates

A player steps on a charged plate to activate it: the boss becomes vulnerable for **20 seconds** (the yellow shield gives way to a white X) and a random character becomes **Powerless** for 8 seconds (the counter heals them for about 1,000 per second); at the end it explodes (5,500 to 8,500 agony damage in a small area), which also hurts the boss. Whoever stands on the plates gets +20 skill. When time runs out, the boss returns to the centre with his shield and the used plate switches off. Use the plates one at a time; when they run out, phase 1 starts again. Repeat until he dies.
If someone stays on a plate that has already been used, the next one will not activate: the whole team has to step off the old plate before activating the next one.

Go through the teleports north of the Maior Domus room and pull the lever: six {creature:Elite Fanatic|Elite Fanatics} appear, and they heal each other a lot (split them up). At around 40% health they turn into {creature:Petrified Fanatic|Petrified Fanatics}, which can be pushed: put **each one** on a richly ornamented floor tile. Once they are all in place, an orange teleport appears in the **north** of the room, leading to the final boss's lever room.

At first {creature:Phosphorus} is invulnerable and shows up with several {creature:Moonsilver Protector|Moonsilver Protectors}: clear them when you can, but the focus is the pedestal mechanic. The room has five 3x4 zones with pedestals, one per vocation. The boss teleports to a zone and a Rival appears in the **north** of the room: pull the boss away from the pedestals and lead the Rival to the zone of **its own vocation**, killing it there (*"YOU CONVERTED THE ENERGY!"*). If you kill it in the wrong place (*"YOU FAILED TO CONVERT THE POWER!"*) the boss gets a charge, becomes stronger and takes less damage. The Rivals hit vocations other than their own harder. The order is always the one in the table.

With 5 Rivals converted (there is a counter on the north wall), the boss goes to the **north** of the room and is vulnerable for **40 seconds** (*"THE TEST BEGINS NOW!"*, *"THE TEST IS NEARLY OVER"* at 20 s, *"THE TEST ENDS NOW!"* at 5 s, *"IT STARTS AGAIN!"* at the end). Repeat the cycle until he flees (*"PHOSPHORUS ESCAPED - CHASE AFTER HIM!"*). A teleport appears to the **east** of the room: it is an object you have to **use** (you cannot just walk into it); the first player to use it takes the whole team to the next room.

In the arena is {creature:Maior Domus (Final)}, with 4 {creature:Moonsilver Sentinel|Moonsilver Sentinels} that keep respawning, while {creature:Mimar Haffar (Final)} casts spells from outside the arena. There are two invulnerable {creature:Storm (Moonsilver)|Storms} that root you (5 s root, renewable) and one more per boss when it reaches 50% health; each new Storm gives the bosses a charge. Maior Domus does not respect Challenge and has to stay **in the centre** of the room: if he leaves it, the centre charges up (*"The middle of the room is charging up!"*) and 3 s later explodes for 3,000+ energy damage, over and over until he returns to the centre. When Maior dies, Mimar enters the arena (he respects Challenge) and casts an agony spell (1,500+) that makes any Storm it hits explode (2,000+ energy).

Mimar Haffar can be attacked at range from the start, from outside the arena. Killing him before Maior Domus means at most 3 Storms in the room and stops him from coming in with 5 charges. When Mimar dies, a teleport appears to the **east**: the first player to use it takes everyone to the last room.

The final form of {creature:Phosphorus (Final)|Phosphorus} does not respect Challenge and can cast Fear. Throughout the fight, {creature:Disruptive Energy|Disruptive Energies} appear (they explode in an area after 4 s if you are close) as well as {item:Sanctified Draining Rift|Sanctified Draining Rifts} (stepping on them takes 40% of your health as agony). Every now and then a character gets cursed (*"You have been cursed."*): they lose 10% of max health per second, up to 8 stacks, and take another 25–30% at the end; this damage ignores Mana Shield, Barrier and Gift of Life. At the same time a {item:Shimmering Field} appears in the room: the cursed player has to step on it straight away to clear the curse (*"The curse fades as you enter the field."*). This is the form that gives loot.
Never ignore the curse: if you do not step on the Shimmering Field, the 8 stacks and the final hit can kill you.

Repeat the fights on the highest difficulty your team can handle (at least 5 for Mimar Haffar and Phosphorus, 7 for Maior Domus), respecting the cooldowns of 20 h (Mimar and Maior) and 2 days and 20 h (final battle). Use the shortcut teleports in the room of {npc:Wayland Smythers} to go straight to each boss. Keep all your {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} until you have at least 2,500.
Scraps of a Radiant Attire (and the rest of the boss loot: Moonsilver Set, crystal coins, potions, gems)
4. Trading the scraps for the outfit and addons
TibiaWiki only says that the outfit and addons are obtained by **trading** the scraps and that this quest's location is Thalassara. The exact NPC or object for the trade is not documented yet.
With the {wiki:Make Believe Quest|Make Believe Quest} complete, trade **2,500** {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} to unlock the base outfit (male and female).

TibiaWiki does not yet name the NPC or object for the trade, only that the quest's location is Thalassara. The only NPC documented at the end of Make Believe is {npc:Wayland Smythers}, in the reward room (teleport to the south-west on the ground floor, after Phosphorus); check there in the game.
Trade another **1,250** {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} to get the first addon.

Trade another **1,250** {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire} to get the second addon. With the full outfit you earn the achievement **Enlightened, Indeed** (2 points): *"You looked into the Light without blinking. Fool or enlightened... who knows?"*
Official artwork of the Illuminated Warrior Outfits
Addon 2 and the Enlightened, Indeed achievement

When you are done, leave Thalassara with a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} or a {wiki:Temple Teleport|Temple Teleport} from the Store, which take you to your home town's temple: the wiki does not document a boat or teleport back (see section 1). To go back and farm, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore takes you to Thalassara for 500 gp.
It does not work in No-Logout Zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block: leave the boss room first and wait for the combat block to wear off.
Cost summary: base outfit 2,500 + addon 1 1,250 + addon 2 1,250 = **5,000** {item:Scraps of a Radiant Attire}.
The wiki's scrap loot data comes from very few recorded kills (10 of Mimar Haffar and 9 of Maior Domus, on unspecified difficulties); the real drop rate may differ.
The difficulty values from which the scraps enter the loot come from the Boss Difficulty System page (checked up to difficulty 25 for Mimar Haffar, 15 for Maior Domus and 28 for Phosphorus).
Since 18 August 2026, the percentage-of-health agony damage in these fights no longer scales with difficulty, but it now ignores Barrier, Magic Shield and Gift of Life.

The mechanics described are those of difficulty 1; higher difficulties add new mechanics (for example, for Maior Domus from difficulty 10: guardians around the plates, two curses at the same time and a root when stepping on the plates).
